title: Current main identity
support: Inspected on 2026-09-09. The execution worker must compare its actual HEAD; never reset newer work.

title: Existing live example configuration
support: v1 currently has two 30-second pollers, 500 calls/run, 8/minute and max_matches=1. PB-01 creates a separate v2 schema/config; no silent reinterpretation.

title: Repository authoring rules
support: Vendor source synchronization and real-session restrictions remain binding. This plan does not forge host approvals or rewrite historical receipts.

title: Offline projector, spool and wire
support: Offline types accept synthetic terminal observations. A new live typed seam is required, not live values disguised as TERMINAL.

title: Offline handoff
support: Final offline evidence is outside Git; it was not re-executed while authoring this package.

title: API-Football quota optimization, 2026-07-27
support: Backend centralization, up to 20 ids, coverage checks, quota headers, errors and avoiding duplicate polls. Actual selected competition still requires a probe.

title: World Cup API guide, 2026-04-13
support: Documents fixtures ids batching and embedded events/lineups/statistics/players, plus 15-second fixture/event refresh. Not a latency SLA or universal completeness guarantee.

title: API-Football getting started, 2026-03-13
support: Account → My Access, x-apisports-key, base URL, response wrapper, status codes, timestamp=kickoff, elapsed=minutes.

title: API-Football pricing
support: Observed listing: Free100/day; Pro $19/month7500/day. Currency/tax/payment terms must be checked at checkout; no automatic purchase.

title: API-Football rate limits, 2026-06-12
support: Per-plan server caps and progressive retry guidance; application cap is intentionally much lower.

title: API v3 reference
support: Official specification entry point. Dynamic page did not expose the full schema to text browsing. Do not claim every response field was independently inspected; PB-18 verifies retained fields against real response.

title: Multiple fixture details tutorial, 2024-12-12
support: Shows /fixtures?ids= with <=20 IDs and detailed objects. Its historical code uses marketplace headers; this plan explicitly uses direct API-Sports header from A3 instead.

title: Chrome Side Panel API
support: User-gesture opening and extension panel integration.

title: Chrome service-worker lifecycle
support: Workers can terminate. State must not depend on an open panel or only global variables.

title: Chrome scripting API
support: Bundled isolated-world script injection; use fixed files, not source strings supplied by pages/backend.

title: Chrome message passing
support: Validate untrusted messages and sender identity. Different entry points have different trust.

title: Python3.12 getpass
support: No-echo input; GetPassWarning means fallback can echo. Treat warning/no controlling TTY as refusal, not fallback.

title: Python3.12 urllib.request
support: Standard-library HTTPS client. Plan-specific policy disables proxy inheritance and redirects and bounds bytes/time.

title: SQLite atomic commit
support: Atomic transaction principle; no claim of hardware/power-loss durability beyond actual platform evidence.

title: WebSocket server API
support: Use existing locked websockets17.1 in repo. Browsed stable documentation identifies17.0.1; verify installed17.1 hook signatures with local tests, do not replace the lock based on page version.

title: JSON canonicalization RFC8785
support: Canonical bytes and domain-separated hashes; preserve existing NFC-rejection policy rather than normalize during hashing.

title: HTTP semantics RFC9110
support: Retry-After supports delta seconds and HTTP dates; this plan defines bounded retry admission.

title: Microsoft WSL networking
support: Windows access to WSL apps through localhost, subject to environment. Must test actual Chrome/WSL topology; never widen listener to0.0.0.0 as fallback.
